name: LinkedIn
description: Replies and monitoring for your LinkedIn account and company.
author: Nextbrowser Team

watchlist.title: Accounts to answer
watchlist.blurb: People and companies whose posts Nextbrowser answers in your browser profile — your own account first. Every pass finds comments and posts nobody from the account has answered yet, shows you each draft, and posts only the replies you approve.
watchlist.subscribeTask: Add {handle} to the LinkedIn reply list: open its LinkedIn profile or company page in the browser profile, confirm it exists and the signed-in account can comment on its posts, and record {handle} in the state file with its newest post as the baseline. React to nothing, connect with nobody and post nothing in this run. If LinkedIn asks for a security check or says the account is restricted, stop and tell me.
watchlist.checkTask: Run one reply pass on LinkedIn in the browser over these accounts: {handles}. Only these accounts are on the list right now. For each, open its recent posts and find comments and posts newer than the recorded baseline that nobody from the signed-in account has answered. Read each one with its thread and write a reply that answers it in a professional, specific voice - never a canned line or a sales pitch. Show me every draft before anything goes out, then post only the ones I approve, a few per pass, and stop at the first failure, security check or restriction. Update the state file.

signIn.probe: (() => { const me = document.querySelector('img.global-nav__me-photo, .global-nav__me img'); const nav = document.querySelector('.global-nav__me, #global-nav'); const wall = /\/(authwall|login|uas\/login|signup|checkpoint)/.test(location.pathname); return { signed_in: !wall && !!nav, handle: me ? (me.getAttribute('alt') || '').trim() : '' }; })()
